transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've been having a really hard time lately because I keep hearing voices that aren't there. Sometimes I see people around me too, even when I know I'm completely alone.

Besides the voices and visions, have you been experiencing any unusual shifts in your mood, such as periods of extreme energy and feeling 'on top of the world,' or conversely, feeling deeply sad and hopeless for long stretches of time?

I’ve been feeling incredibly sad and empty for a long time now, and I just can't seem to shake this deep sense of hopelessness. I don't have any energy at all, and I certainly don't feel "on top of the world"—in fact, I struggle to find interest in anything anymore.
Do you experience these voices and visions only when you are feeling at your absolute lowest point, or do they also persist during times when your mood is relatively more stable?
The voices and visions are always there, regardless of how I'm feeling. They don't go away even when my mood isn't as low as it usually is.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were [Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type), Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features]. Because the patient reports that the psychotic symptoms (voices and visions) persist independently of their mood state (even when they are not at their 'lowest point'), the criteria for Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features are less likely, as those symptoms typically only occur during a major depressive episode. Therefore, Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) is now the primary candidate.
